meta.title: Mia · TaxiBots
meta.description: Mia TaxiBots for Save the World: join missions and zones even if you haven’t unlocked them, with bots ready to help you farm, complete objectives, and access bot lobbies.
meta.ogDescription: Mia TaxiBots for Save the World: join missions and zones even if you haven’t unlocked them, with bots ready to help you farm, complete objectives, and access bot lobbies.

hero.title: Mia TaxiBots
hero.subtitle: STW missions and bot matches when you need them
hero.lead: Automated accounts connected to the Fortnite client. Use them to enter Save the World missions above your power level or to play bot lobbies in Battle Royale.

howTo.title: How to use TaxiBots
howTo.lead: Follow these steps in Discord and Fortnite. Invite a taxi, set don’t fill, and play.

steps.title: Join Mia Lounge
steps.text: Enter the Mia Lounge server.

steps.title: Register your account
steps.text: Register your account in Mia with /registrar.

steps.title: Add your account to the taxis
steps.text: Use /taxibot (activar) to add your account to the system.

steps.title: Add a bot
steps.text: Add a TaxiBot as a friend in Fortnite. Check names with /taxibot opción:Información or in the fleet below.

steps.title: Invite a taxi
steps.text: Invite an available taxi to your party.

steps.title: Don’t fill and play
steps.text: Set your match to don’t fill and start on time (6 min free · 8 min premium).

features.title: What they’re for
features.lead: Access STW content and relaxed matches without relying only on your progress.

items.title: Advanced STW missions
items.text: Enter missions with a higher PL than yours when you haven’t unlocked the zone.

items.title: Bot lobbies in BR
items.text: Premium users can start matchmaking with bots for calmer matches.

items.title: Real automated accounts
items.text: TaxiBots are accounts connected to a legitimate client, managed by Mia.

items.title: Orderly use
items.text: One taxi at a time if you’re not premium, 10 s cooldown between invites, and the bot leaves if you don’t start on time.

commands.title: Discord commands
commands.lead: The /taxibot command uses the opción option with four values: Activar, Desactivar, Información, and Estado.

items.text: Adds your account to the system so bots accept your friend request.
Removes your account from the TaxiBots system when you no longer need it.

compare.lead: Compare what you get with free bots and Mia Premium.

fleet.title: Live fleet
fleet.lead: Status updated from Mia’s API. Filter by name, type, or availability.

card.empty: No bots match the current filter.
card.error: Could not load the fleet. Check that the bot API is online.

notice: Wait 10 s between invites to different bots. Don’t spam: the system blocks it and you could be banned.

cta.title: Need help with TaxiBots?
cta.text: Check the FAQ guide, ask on Discord, or unlock bot lobbies with Mia Premium.
